observations: Photo 0 shows a black 3-piece speaker system with a central subwoofer and two satellite speakers, all with orange accents on the speaker cones.
The subwoofer has a digital display showing 'RUSH 0' in red LED.
The front panel has buttons for power, volume, input selection, and other controls.
Photo 1 shows the same system from a slightly different angle, with the LG logo visible on the front of the subwoofer.
The system appears to be on a marble-patterned surface, and there is a black cable visible on the left side.
The seller's watermark 'RIVERS SPORTS PORT' is overlaid on both photos.

claims.evidence: The term 'advanced eq' and 'bass blast+' are subjective marketing claims not verifiable from photos alone.

claims.claim: deeper bass and clearer vocals are made possible with bass...
claims.evidence: Subjective marketing claim; cannot be verified from photos.

risks.risk: The system may not be functional (e.g., speakers may be damaged, subwoofer may not work, or internal components may be faulty).
risks.proof: A video showing the system powered on, playing audio, and all speakers responding to volume and input controls.

risks.risk: The speakers or subwoofer may have physical damage not visible in the photos (e.g., cracks, dents, or loose parts).
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the front, back, and sides of each speaker and subwoofer, showing all angles and edges.

risks.risk: The system may be missing accessories (e.g., remote, cables, or power adapter).
risks.proof: Photo showing all included accessories laid out next to the system.

proof_requests: Video of the system powered on and playing audio from all speakers.
Close-up photos of the front, back, and sides of each speaker and subwoofer.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
